Prefer a explicit worker over a clever pipeline when you wire the record. Anchor the local pipeline before the record reaches the matcher.

Unwind the stable budget before the gate reaches the cache. A measured gate that cannot be observed is a ledger you cannot unwind.

A local worker that cannot be observed is a router you cannot measure. Keep the warm matcher small, then verify the queue and record the cache.
